title.en_US: Vinput 2.3.7 — Unified hotword weights and safer parsing
title.zh_CN: Vinput 2.3.7 — 统一热词权重格式与输入校验

text.en_US: Hotword files now use one entry per line with optional term:weight syntax and no spaces around the colon. Vinput validates weights and UTF-8 before passing entries to sherpa-onnx, preventing malformed input from crashing ASR. X-ASR models installed before 2.3.6 still need to be re-downloaded for hotwords.
text.zh_CN: 热词文件现在统一为每行一个词条，可选权重格式为“词条:权重”，冒号两边不能有空格。Vinput 会在交给 sherpa-onnx 前校验权重与 UTF-8，避免异常输入导致 ASR 崩溃。2.3.6 之前安装的 X-ASR 模型仍需重新下载，热词才能生效。
